rows.ARS:
Deep pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WEKchrisg
Exhibition name: Crowd Pleaser ™
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Chris Greenwood (United States, 1995).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2001 as 'Crowd Pleaser'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Mild fragrance. 30 to 40 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
